sentences.text: Researchers adjusted the chemical structure of quasi-2D perovskite materials by changing a specific numerical parameter called the nominal n value to create optoelectronic synapses for vision systems. Adding the n = 2 phase to the material allowed it to absorb light up to 600 nm, creating distinct electrical responses to blue, green, and red light.

A specific mixture with a nominal n value of 1.2 absorbed red light well while stopping harmful ion movement, resulting in very straight-line changes in electrical current. The team built a mathematical model using the material's responses to light color, brightness, and time to estimate electrical warnings for blue light hazards and known damage thresholds.
The authors state that this method offers a way to combine color selection and linear signal processing at the material level for vision systems.
